technical_map.question: Muse Spark Open：开放模型的成绩，怎样才算可比较？

editorial: FieldToFit分析：开放权重提高了部署与修改的控制权，但不能替你完成设备、任务和权限验证。先选择自己的验收样本，再用作者成绩决定值得测试什么。
对照来源、框架和量尺，是把模型发布读成采用方案的关键。本文的并行连线仅组织需要同时核对的证据，不主张模型训练的因果继承。
方法PDF仅标 2026-10；模型卡与公告明确模型发布日 2026-10-15。本站核对日 2026-10-16 与实际网站发表分别保存。无独立修订号；完整安全评估报告仍待发布。原文与原图仅链接，三图为本站原创重绘，不声称复现、价格降低或全场景安全。

blocks.text: Muse Spark Open把编码、工具使用和多模态输入放在同一开放检查点中。MoE只激活部分专家，意味着每个token的计算路径较稀疏；本站据此提醒：不要把激活参数直接当成需要下载、存储或驻留的全部权重。

items: 模型卡列出 816B总参数、42B激活，以及文字／图像／视频／音频输入和文字输出；不是一个文字输出之外的通用生成套件。
NVFP4 至少 700GB显存、BF16 至少 2TB是作者列出的运行要求；双M5 Ultra演示也依赖大容量统一内存，不能转述成普通个人电脑均可部署。

blocks.label: limit
blocks.text: FieldToFit判断：选型前先确认机器容量、精度、框架与任务，再讨论是否适合本地运行。

findings.summary: 开放的是配置和部署选择，硬件门槛仍要看完整检查点与精度。

fields.361 任务、排除Google Drive、每题 4 次、最多 200 步。: 361 tasks, Google Drive excluded, 4 attempts each, up to 200 steps.
fields.80.4 与 89.2，不能平均成一个Agent成功率: 80.4 and 89.2 are not one average agent success rate
fields.816B 总参数／42B 激活；推理上下文 1M；作者评测采用 xhigh。: 816B total / 42B active; 1M inference context; author evaluations use xhigh.
fields.AA 指数取 2026-10-07；编程任务采用不同首选Agent框架。: The AA index uses 2026-10-07 data; coding tasks use different preferred agent harnesses.
fields.FieldToFit 本站原创重绘；依据 Meta 的 Muse Spark O: Original FieldToFit redraw based on Meta’s official Muse Spark Open materials.
fields.FieldToFit分析：开放权重提高了部署与修改的控制权，但不能替你完成设备、: FieldToFit analysis: open weights increase deployment and modification control without performing device, task or permission validation for you. Define acceptance samples first, then use author scores to decide what deserves testing.
fields.FieldToFit判断：用你自己的任务集合验证完成质量、失败恢复与资源占用，再: FieldToFit assessment: evaluate completion quality, failure recovery and resource use on your own tasks before replacing the existing system.
fields.FieldToFit判断：选型前先确认机器容量、精度、框架与任务，再讨论是否适合: FieldToFit assessment: confirm capacity, precision, runtime and tasks before deciding whether local deployment fits.
fields.GUI奖励与MCP任务通过率采用不同分母、规则和工具。: GUI reward and MCP task pass rate use different denominators, rules and tools.
fields.GUI子集的平均奖励: Mean reward on a GUI subset
fields.MCP-Atlas的 1000 是基准总任务量；89.2%的实际公开／私有spl: The 1000 MCP-Atlas tasks describe the benchmark. This methodology does not separately identify the public/private split denominator underlying 89.2%. We retain that gap rather than infer how many tasks passed.
fields.MCP任务按覆盖阈值判通过: MCP tasks pass a claim-coverage threshold
fields.MoE Transformer 与感知编码器，原生多模态输入、文字输出。: A MoE Transformer and perception encoder accept multimodal input and return text.
fields.Muse Spark Open把编码、工具使用和多模态输入放在同一开放检查点中。: Muse Spark Open combines coding, tool use and multimodal input in one open checkpoint. MoE activates only some experts, making each token’s computation sparse. Our reading is to avoid equating active parameters with all weights to download, store or keep resident.
fields.Muse Spark Open提供可自托管的多模态检查点；判断是否适合采用，应同: Muse Spark Open offers a self-hostable multimodal checkpoint. Adoption requires task/scoring details, provenance, hardware and licensing; rankings or local speedups are not business guarantees.
fields.Muse Spark Open：开放模型的成绩，怎样才算可比较？: Muse Spark Open: what makes open-model scores comparable?
fields.NVFP4 至少 700GB显存、BF16 至少 2TB是作者列出的运行要求；双: The author lists at least 700GB VRAM for NVFP4 and 2TB for BF16; the two M5 Ultra demonstration also relies on large unified memory. This is not support for every ordinary personal computer.
fields.NVIDIA／AMD内核；端到端结果明确为AMD MI350。: NVIDIA / AMD kernels; the end-to-end result specifically uses AMD MI350;
fields.OSWorld与MCP-Atlas的任务范围、工具和评分方式对照: OSWorld and MCP-Atlas task scope, tools and scoring
fields.OSWorld为 361 任务子集，排除Google Drive依赖任务；只有G: OSWorld uses a 361-task subset excluding Google Drive dependencies, GUI only, at most 200 steps and four-attempt averaging. These are concrete constraints, not coverage of every desktop application.
fields.不是任意电脑任务的成功概率；Kimi为自报，坐标约定也不同。: Not a success probability for arbitrary desktop tasks; Kimi is self-reported and coordinate conventions differ.
fields.不能相乘、推广到所有硬件或推导API价格。: Do not multiply them, generalize to all hardware or infer API prices.
fields.两个数来自不同任务系统。OSWorld让Agent操作完整桌面，检查最终状态；M: The values come from different task systems. OSWorld asks an agent to operate a desktop and checks final state. MCP-Atlas evaluates tool tasks through claim coverage and a pass threshold. Showing both identifies coverage; averaging them removes their measurement meaning.
fields.主流开放模型的Agent评测与采用边界: Agent evaluation and adoption boundaries for a mainstream open model
fields.任务成绩不直接替代现场验证: Task scores do not replace application validation
fields.作者评测未复现；报告月份精度保留。MCP本行split分母未明确，第三方框架不同: Author evaluations were not reproduced; preserve month precision. The MCP score’s split denominator is unspecified, third-party harnesses differ and full safety reporting is pending.
fields.保留原始日期精度；本站阅读和发布不冒充上游修订。: Retain source date precision; local reading and site publication are not upstream revisions.
fields.先核对量尺，再决定是否采用: Check the measure before choosing the model
fields.先看成绩出处与Agent框架，再看名次: Read score provenance and agent harnesses before ranks

fields.内核提速，不自动变成整条工作流同幅提速: Kernel speedups do not guarantee equal workflow gains
fields.内部运行、榜单快照与厂商自报不能被写成同一场统一测试。: Internal runs, leaderboard snapshots and provider reports are not one uniform evaluation.
fields.原文仅链接，本站图形为原创事实重绘: Link upstream text only; FieldToFit diagrams are original factual redraws
fields.发布文章把Helion内核优化与整体推理收益分开报告。FieldToFit保留这: The launch post separates Helion kernel optimization from whole-inference gains. We preserve that distinction: workflows include operations outside those kernels, so a maximum local multiplier does not promise the same gain for a machine, every task or API pricing.
fields.发布配置与评测出处分别核对: Check release configuration and evaluation provenance separately
fields.只允许截图与GUI操作，按最终虚拟机状态给奖励。: Screenshot and GUI actions only; final VM state determines reward.
fields.可自托管或使用第三方API。: Self-hosting or third-party APIs are available.
fields.图 1｜本站重绘。MCP基准总量不等于已核实的本行成绩分母；两列不能合成总准确率: Figure 1 | FieldToFit redraw. Benchmark size is not a verified denominator for the reported MCP score; the columns do not form an overall accuracy.
fields.图 2｜本站重绘。AA指数与部分工作任务数据使用 10 月 7 日快照；未报告不: Figure 2 | FieldToFit redraw. The AA index and some work-task figures use the 10/7 snapshot; unavailable results do not mean zero capability.

fields.基准含 1000 任务、公开／私有各 500，36 个服务与 220 工具。: The benchmark has 1000 tasks, public / private splits of 500 each, 36 servers and 220 tools.
fields.完整安全报告待发布；微调或量化后的结果不自动继承原检查点结论。: Full safety reporting is pending; modified or quantized models do not automatically inherit the released checkpoint’s results.
fields.对照来源、框架和量尺，是把模型发布读成采用方案的关键。本文的并行连线仅组织需要同: Checking sources, harnesses and measures turns a release into an adoption assessment. Parallel links organize evidence to check together; they do not assert causal training inheritance.
fields.将权重、工具权限、运行框架和业务评测作为整体。: Treat weights, tool permissions, runtime and task evaluation as a system.
fields.局部优化、端到端收益、许可与安全是不同采用条件。: Kernel optimization, end-to-end gain, licensing and safety are separate adoption conditions.
